Name: Prismatic Tools
Author: stokastic
Description:
[size=4]NOTEABLE FEATURES:[/size]
[list]
[*]The hoe and watering can have an improved 5x7 coverage (almost double that of iridium)
[*]The Axe and Pickaxe can oneshot all trees and all rocks
[*]The sprinklers have 7x7 coverage (Configurable)
[*]Prismatic sprinklers also act as lamps and scarecrows (toggleable in config file, default true)
[/list]
[size=4]INSTALL[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into[code] ﻿Stardew Valley/﻿Mods﻿.[/code]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]USAGE[/size]
Forge prismatic bars in the furnace with prismatic shards and coal. Bars can be used to craft sprinklers at level 9 farming, or used to upgrade your tools at the blacksmith for a hefty price.

[size=4]COMPATIBILITY[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3.28 on Windows.
[/list]
[size=4]SEE ALSO[/size][list]
[*][url=https://github.com/stokastic/PrismaticTools]Source Code[/url]﻿
[/list]
